source.provider: International GNSS Service (IGS), merged broadcast navigation data (BRDC), from the BKG data centre; freely available, IGS asks to be cited

selection: For each Galileo, GLONASS and BeiDou satellite, the healthy record (Galileo: SV health 0 in an I/NAV record, data source bit 0 or 2; GLONASS: health Bn 0; BeiDou: SatH1 0) whose reference time (toe, or tb, in GPS time) is nearest the reference epoch, the earlier on a tie. Checks: each satellite's records of the same kind nearest the reference epoch +/- 3, 6, 9 and 12 h, within 1 h of the mark and at least 1 h from the selected record; for GPS (health 0) the records nearest the reference epoch and +/- 3, 6, 9 and 12 h.
